name: shopify-storefront
description: Three Shopify skills: campaign-launcher plans a campaign from one sentence or its materials (one-line plan kept in one artifact, calendar invite), readies the website on an unpublished copy, drafts email, SMS and ads as stubs, and schedules Launch and Stop; campaign-page generates a campaign landing page template whose sections swap with one switch in the theme editor or by asking Claude; theme-editor matches the theme's colours (and fonts if asked) to the style guide. Both work through the Shopify connector or CLI and read BRAND.md, BRAND-VOICE.md and THEME-SPECIFICS.md.
